# Psalm 78 — Disagreement Log

## 78:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-maskil of-Asaph. Give-ear my-people to-my-teaching; incline your-ear to-words-of my-mouth.
- **LOGOS:** A Maskil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my teaching; incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
- **PNEUMA:** A contemplative poem of Asaph. My people, listen to what I'm about to teach you. Open your ears to what I have to say.
